Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

moment noun

a point in time

also at that moment, at the right moment, the moment (that), just in time, in the nick of time, you’ve come in the nick of time, at the critical moment, in the course of time, as time went on, at the very moment, at the same moment, at the very same moment

classical

Ter. Heaut. 2.3.123: in tempore ad eam vēnī (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Off. 1.27: ad tempus, for the moment (Lewis & Short)

tempus, temporis n.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

the moment, the time (for something)

in tempore, at the right moment, just in time; ad tempus, on time, or for the moment; the very moment takes ipse (see just, exactly). “At the moment”, now, is nunc or in praesentiā (see now).

Other words

  • opportūnē — at just the right moment

    adverb · also used · classical · Ter. Heaut. 179: Pater, opportūnē advenīs.; Ter. Ad. 81: Ehem, opportūnē

  • ut prīmum (cum prīmum, simul ac) — the moment (that), as soon as

    also used · classical · Sen. Ep. 104.6: ut prīmum gravitātem urbis excessī; Varr. RR 3.2.18: simul ac prōmīseris; Liv. 21.1.4: cum prīmum posset; Traupman 88: as soon as, cum prīmum

  • in ipsō articulō temporis — at the critical moment, in the nick of time

    also used · classical · Cic. Quinct. 19: in ipsō articulō temporis, “at the most critical moment” (Lewis & Short s.v. articulus); Traupman 104: you’ve come in the nick of time, in ipsō articulō temporis advenīs

    Articulus is a joint, so a turning point in time. For arriving just when wanted, the comic poets say opportūnē advenīs.

Examples

  • Pater, opportūnē advenīs.

    Father, you’ve come at just the right moment.Ter. Heaut. 179

  • quīn simul ac prōmīseris minerval, incipiam

    why, I’ll begin the moment you’ve promised my feeVarr. RR 3.2.18

  • In ipsō articulō temporis advenīs.

    You’ve come in the nick of time.Traupman 104

  • prōcēdente tempore

    in the course of timeTraupman 298

  • ipsō tempore

    at the very momentTraupman 347

  • pūnctō temporis eōdem

    at the very same momentTraupman 347

See also moment, now, just, in good time.
